scope: bounded regional, public-datasets-only, non-operational technical preview

supported_reference_operations.name: reference_measures
supported_reference_operations.semantics: cumulative opportunity, gravity and two-step floating-catchment measures

supported_reference_operations.name: reference_matrix_comparison
supported_reference_operations.semantics: status-preserving pairwise comparison with impedance deltas

supported_reference_operations.name: partition_and_incremental_recompute
supported_reference_operations.semantics: deterministic origin partitions and fingerprint-aware changed-row recomputation

supported_reference_operations.name: time_capacity_reference_projection
supported_reference_operations.semantics: minute-based arrival/opening projection using caller-supplied intervals and capacities

required_semantics.missing_data: preserve missing and unreachable as distinct; never infer negative evidence
required_semantics.uncertainty: caller supplies scenario assumptions, subgroup dimensions and uncertainty method
required_semantics.provenance: inputs must be versioned or content-addressed by the caller
required_semantics.authority: reference outputs are descriptive and non-authoritative

disabled_adapters_and_claims: real road, walk, cycle or public-transport routing
timetable and timezone or holiday service interpretation
open_gates: named archived network, timetable and facility inputs
elapsed beta/RC evidence and accountable release-authority decision
nonclaims: This freeze defines a bounded interface and reference examples; it is not a release approval.
The reference operations do not establish national coverage, service availability, routing validity or authoritative accessibility.
